Recomputed z: candidate mean (0.087+0.0804)/2 = 0.0837, incumbent 0.0942, gap 0.0105. SE = 0.0049*sqrt(1/2+1/1) = 0.0060, so z ≈ 1.75. The incumbent has only one run, so the comparison rests on few runs. z of about 1.75 is borderline, and one confirmation replicate would be worth spending.

If the fingerprint comes first, the Tanimoto kNN runs on the tail of the fingerprint plus the binarised descriptors. The result would be weaker but still valid. Check the column order.
